purpose: Assess volume-mesh sensitivity of apparent axial stiffness before gradient validation
geometry: Same analyzed G24 R0 piecewise-planar binary domain
method: Gmsh Relocate3D, 10 iterations; boundary coordinates and tetrahedron connectivity unchanged

predeclared_screening.physical_consistency: All existing native ODB acceptance checks must pass

limits: Screening thresholds are working criteria, not rigorous error bounds
Small energy share of poor elements does not bound stiffness error
Maximum local stress is diagnostic only; no convergence claim
No USDFLD, contact, plasticity or global optimizer changes
